hook.name: MarketHoursFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies a dynamic LP fee based on US equity market sessions (regular, extended, or closed), charging a base fee plus a time-of-day surcharge derived from block.timestamp and US Eastern time, to compensate LPs for stale-price risk outside trading hours. The hook holds no funds, has no owner, and cannot revert inside a swap.
